chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutevakil (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: He narrated to me Ali ibn al-Hussein al-Sa'ed Abady, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Yunus ibn Abdul-Rahman, from Davood ibn Farqad, who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said:
Anger is the key to all evil.
ai.seo_question: What is the key to all evil according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq presents this concise maxim from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to establish anger as the root cause (*asbab*) of all moral and spiritual decay. This teaching underscores the Shia emphasis on *adab al-nafs* (self-discipline), positioning the control of wrath as the foundational step toward achieving comprehensive virtue and averting diverse evils.
